6 Requirements Tracing
The following tables reference the requirements specified in [3] and [9] and links to the
fulfillment of these. Please note that if column “Satisfied by” is empty for a specific
requirement this means that this requirement is not fulfilled by this document.
Requirement
Description
Satisfied by
[SRS_BSW_00004]
All Basic SW Modules shall perform a
pre-processor check of the versions
of all imported include files
[SWS_LinSM_00208]
[SRS_BSW_00101]
The Basic Software Module shall be
able to initialize variables and
hardware in a separate initialization
function
[SWS_LinSM_00155]
[SRS_BSW_00167]
All AUTOSAR Basic Software
Modules shall provide configuration
rules and constraints to enable
plausibility checks
[SWS_LinSM_00073]
[SRS_BSW_00358]
The return type of init() functions
implemented by AUTOSAR Basic
Software Modules shall be void
[SWS_LinSM_00155]
[SRS_BSW_00369]
All AUTOSAR Basic Software
Modules shall not return specific
development error codes via the API
[SWS_LinSM_00113] [SWS_LinSM_00122]
[SWS_LinSM_00126]
[SRS_BSW_00373]
The main processing function of each
AUTOSAR Basic Software Module
shall be named according the defined
convention
[SWS_LinSM_00156]
[SRS_BSW_00384]
The Basic Software Module
specifications shall specify at least in
the description which other modules
they require
[SWS_LinSM_00001] [SWS_LinSM_00085]
[SWS_LinSM_00086] [SWS_LinSM_00105]
[SWS_LinSM_00196]

API handling in uninitialized state
